title: Great Glassware!
text: Great Glassware!. This is great glassware! I love the unique shape of them. They're like goblets. My husband was cracking jokes referring to the 3rd Indiana Jones move! All kidding aside, we love these! My husband has been using one for his beer from the keg and I used one for margaritas. It comes with shot glasses too, which are perfect for making drinks because of the measurements on them. The glasses are sturdy and so far they seem very durable.
